review: Source-only follow-up: exact median accounting in text JSON decoder paired runner
review_scope: Only the accounting change to paired summary median and its regression tests; no Cargo, product execution, or timing was run by reviewer.

finding.previous_issue: The runner converted statistics.median(valid) to int, discarding a possible half-nanosecond median for an even number of paired deltas.
finding.current_behavior: The summary now stores statistics.median(valid) directly, preserving integer medians for odd counts and half-valued medians for even counts. JSON supports the resulting .5 numeric value.
finding.regression_coverage: Added odd- and even-count median assertions; source was inspected but tests were not rerun by this reviewer. Owner reports 10 tests passing with one expected prebuild-provenance skip.

assessment: Clear for the reported median-accounting fix. Product, harness, build driver, and source-map pins are unchanged from the prior review; runner/test hashes bind the follow-up. This review does not certify build outputs or any benchmark result.
